gloss: to take measures; to strike a deal; to clap hands

definitions.gloss: to take measures; to take action; to do something about
definitions.explanation: To take steps or countermeasures to address a problem or situation.

definitions.gloss: to strike a deal; to reach an agreement; to settle
definitions.explanation: To come to terms or reach a mutually acceptable agreement, often in negotiations.
The literal meaning - to clap one's hands, as in applause or to get attention.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに{手|て}を{打|う}った。
{被害|ひがい}が{広|ひろ}がる{前|まえ}に{手|て}を{打|う}たなければならない。
examples.english: We must take measures before the damage spreads.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}らかの{手|て}を{打|う}たないと、{状況|じょうきょう}はさらに{悪化|あっか}するだろう。
examples.english: If we don't take some kind of action, the situation will only get worse.

examples.japanese: この{条件|じょうけん}で{手|て}を{打|う}とう。
examples.english: Let's strike a deal on these terms.

examples.japanese: この{辺|へん}りで{手|て}を{打|う}ちませんか。
{双方|そうほう}が{譲歩|じょうほ}して、ようやく{手|て}を{打|う}つことができた。
examples.english: Both sides made concessions, and they were finally able to reach an agreement.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{打|う}って{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: I clapped my hands with joy.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}は{手|て}を{打|う}って{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The audience clapped their hands with excitement.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{手|て}を{打|う}ちながら{歌|うた}っていた。
examples.english: The children were singing while clapping their hands.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
{手|て} (hand) + を + {打|う}つ (to strike/hit)

MULTIPLE MEANINGS:
This expression has distinct meanings based on context:

1. TAKE MEASURES:
・{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take action/countermeasures
・{先手|せんて}を{打|う}つ - to make the first move
・{早|はや}めに{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take early action

2. STRIKE A DEAL:
Originates from the custom of clapping hands together to seal an agreement.
・この{辺|へん}で{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to settle around here
・{手|て}を{打|う}って{合意|ごうい}する - to reach a handshake agreement

3. CLAP HANDS (literal):
・{手|て}を{打|う}って{喜|よろこ}ぶ - to clap hands in joy
・{三三七拍子|さんさんななびょうし}で{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to clap in 3-3-7 rhythm

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{対策|たいさく}の{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take countermeasures
・{何|なん}らかの{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take some kind of action
・{適切|てきせつ}な{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take appropriate measures

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in business and everyday contexts.

forms.negative: {手|て}を{打|う}ちませんでした

forms.negative: {手|て}を{打|う}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {手|て}を{打|う}っていませんでした
